title: Data Operations Run and Retry Permission Consistency

items.action: run or retry a duplicate-check operation

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

audit.reason: Existing operation create/start/retry audit behavior is unchanged.

menu.reason: Read navigation remains independent from running or retrying a data operation.

route_guard.reason: Read access and operation actions remain separate concerns.

notes: Duplicate Check Run and Retry each use fair_crm.operations.execute as their single canonical business permission. Immediate CreateOperation and StartOperation use that permission for the initial run, while RetryOperation already checks the same permission and DuplicateCheckHandler now propagates that authorization context to the downstream data-operation start instead of requiring fair_crm.admin.data_operations.execute again. Route guards remain out of scope.
